intro: I like understanding how systems fit together, why they are built the way they are, and what technical choices lead to. experience.role: Student assistant and mentor in backend and cybersecurity

about:
I am most at home in the backend: APIs, data flow, integrations and tests that describe how the system should actually behave. I am happy to take the frontend too, so I can deliver a feature all the way from database to screen.

I started out with mathematics and computer science at the University of Oslo in 1992. Then the kitchen took over for many years, before I came back to code in 2023.
beforeCode:
Certified chef, head chef at the Henie Onstad Art Centre, and owner and manager of Holmestrand Fjordhotell for almost seven years. Before that I was a team leader in a customer service centre.

It taught me to deliver under time pressure, lead people and run a business.

stack.tools: C#/.NET, REST API, MediatR, MassTransit, Node.js and TypeScript (Fastify)
